fusions.name: Galley Scraps
fusions.desc: Flings scraps that deal 3 damage and leave the target [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Overrun
fusions.desc: Pours over every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 14 damage and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Last Off the Ship
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Stowaway Brood
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded bilge rat that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1 second within 4.5 tiles.
